items.source: The default value is true, which means that an annotated class will inherit the listeners defined by an annotated superclass or enclosing class. Specifically, the listeners for an annotated class will be appended to the list of listeners defined by an annotated superclass or enclosing class. Thus, subclasses and nested classes have the option of extending the list of listeners. In the following example, AbstractBaseTest will be configured with DependencyInjectionTestExecutionListener and DirtiesContextTestExecutionListener; whereas, TransactionalTest will be configured with DependencyInjectionTestExecutionListener, DirtiesContextTestExecutionListener, and TransactionalTestExecutionListener, in that order.
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`，这意味着一个带注解的类将 继承 由带注解的父类或外部类定义的监听器。具体而言，带注解的类的监听器将被追加到由带注解的父类或外部类定义的监听器列表中。因此，子类及内部类有选项来 扩展 监听器列表。在以下示例中，AbstractBaseTest 将配置为使用 DependencyInjectionTestExecutionListener 和 DirtiesContextTestExecutionListener；而 TransactionalTest 将按顺序配置为使用 DependencyInjectionTestExecutionListener、DirtiesContextTestExecutionListener、以及 TransactionalTestExecutionListener。

items.source: This attribute may not be used in conjunction with listeners(), but it may be used instead of listeners().
items.translation: 此属性不能与listeners()一起使用，但可以作为listeners()的替代方案。

items.source: @TestExecutionListeners is used to register listeners for a particular test class, its subclasses, and its nested classes. If you wish to register a listener globally, you should register it via the automatic discovery mechanism described in TestExecutionListener.
items.translation: @TestExecutionListeners 用于为特定的测试类、其子类及其嵌套类注册监听器。如果您希望全局注册一个监听器，则应通过TestExecutionListener中描述的自动发现机制进行注册。

items.source: If inheritListeners is set to false, the listeners for the annotated class will shadow and effectively replace any listeners defined by a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 如果将 `inheritListeners` 设置为 `false，则注解类的监听器将 遮蔽 并实际上替换由父类或外部类定义的任意监听器。

items.source: Can be set to MERGE_WITH_DEFAULTS to have locally declared listeners merged with the default listeners.
items.translation: 可设置为 `MERGE_WITH_DEFAULTS`，以使本地声明的监听器与默认监听器进行合并。

items.source: If you extend a class that is annotated with @TestExecutionListeners and you need to switch to using the default set of listeners, you can annotate your class with the following.
items.translation: 如果您扩展了带有 `@TestExecutionListeners` 注解的类，并且需要切换到使用默认监听器集，您可以使用以下注解来标注您的类。

items.source: Defaults to REPLACE_DEFAULTS for backwards compatibility.
items.translation: 默认为REPLACE_DEFAULTS，以向后兼容。

items.source:
The mode is ignored if listeners are inherited from a superclass or
enclosing class.
items.translation: 如果监听器是从父类或外部类继承的，则忽略该模式。

items.translation: 与TestContextManager注册的TestExecutionListeners。

items.source: Whether TestExecutionListeners from superclasses and enclosing classes should be inherited.
items.translation: 超类和包含类中的 `TestExecutionListeners` 是否应该被继承。

items.source: This attribute may not be used in conjunction with value(), but it may be used instead of value().
items.translation: 此属性不能与value()一起使用，但可以作为value()的替代方案。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations. In addition, this annotation will be inherited from an enclosing test class by default. See @NestedTestConfiguration for details.
items.translation: 此注解可用作元注解来创建自定义的组合注解。此外，默认情况下，该注解将从外部测试类继承。有关详细信息，请参阅@NestedTestConfiguration。

items.source: Enumeration of modes that dictate whether explicitly declared listeners are merged with the default listeners when @TestExecutionListeners is declared on a class that does not inherit listeners from a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 枚举 模式，用于规定当在类上声明了 @TestExecutionListeners 且该类未从父类或外部类继承监听器时，显式声明的监听器是否与默认监听器合并。

items.source: The merge mode to use when @TestExecutionListeners is declared on a class that does not inherit listeners from a superclass or enclosing class.
items.translation: 当 `@TestExecutionListeners` 声明在一个不继承自父类或外部类的监听器的类上时，要使用的合并模式。
